subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 123 Hundreds Tens Ones 123 = 1 hundreds, 2 tens and 3 ones In expanded form, 123 = 100 + 20 + 3 The digit 1 in 123 is in the hundreds place. The digit 2 in 123 is in the tens place. The digit 3 in 123 is in the ones place. The value of 1 in 123 is 100. The value of 2 in 123 is 20. The value of 3 in 123 is 3. Can you count forward from 123 to 126? 342 Hundreds Tens Ones 342 = 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 2 ones In expanded form, 342= 300 + 40 + 2 The digit 3 in 342 is in the hundreds place. The digit 4 in 342 is in the tens place. The digit 2 in 342 is in ones place. The value of 3 in 342 is 300. 3
